release_notes.en-US: Initial private release. Automatically selects Don't show this again and confirms the Microsoft Online Stay signed in prompt. Runs only on the relevant Microsoft sign-in page and collects, stores, and transmits no user data.

version.approval_notes: Unlisted extension intended for personal use. Runs only on https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/SAS/ProcessAuth. The readable content script selects the DontShowAgain checkbox and clicks the submit input, with a 15-second timeout. No data collection, storage, transmission, analytics, telemetry, remote code, external services, transpilation, bundling, minification, or obfuscation.
